# 03-03 網頁主視覺延伸

工具：內建 imagegen。以原動畫的生成情境圖作編輯參考，原動畫圖片保持不變。
參考：`outputs/ecology-ai-rollout-assets/03-03/hero-v01/03-03-little-owl-context.png`

```text
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: full-width hero image for a Traditional Chinese natural-history science website.
Edit the supplied generated little owl image into a wider cinematic 21:9 composition. Extend the existing orchard and low stone wall naturally, so the image can continue visually into the next reading section. Keep the same single Athene noctua, anatomy, detailed brown and white streaked feathers, flat head without ear tufts, natural yellow eyes, small body and feet. Do not create a second owl or a different individual.
Composition: retain the owl and its stone perch in the left third, the owl's entire body visible and about 48 percent of the frame height. Add natural open orchard space and softly receding trees to the right two-thirds, with the right-middle area quiet and softly defocused for a large white headline. Keep the orchard grounded below the distant horizon; avoid an oversized empty sky. The foreground stone wall should continue toward the lower-right edge with real texture and environmental depth, not be a pasted cutout.
Lighting and style: preserve the reference's natural dusk, muted gray-blue distance, warm stone and credible wildlife-editorial photographic appearance. The image must feel like one continuous environment. Retain detailed plumage and realistic scale. No dramatic glowing eyes, no light beams.
Constraints: no text, typography, graphic waves, microphone, UI, artificial frame, logos, watermark, duplicate owl or imaginary equipment. This remains a generated species context illustration, not an actual research record or a labeled individual's portrait. Output a landscape 21:9 image.
```
